papers.practical_value: 该工作为混合SWA和MoE架构的大规模部署提供了工程实践指南，尤其适用于需要处理多模态输入的生产环境，可显著降低推理成本和延迟。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文展示了从理论架构到生产系统的工程挑战和解决方案，对于关注LLM推理系统优化和混合注意力机制落地的研究者和工程师具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Guess Where You Go: Generative Next Point-of-Interest Recommendation in Amap
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval enables recommender systems to retrieve items by generating compact item identifiers, but scaling it to industrial scenarios remains challenging due to redundant or colliding token assignments and insufficient integration of heterogeneous item signals. These challenges are particularly critical for next Point-of-Interest (POI) recommendation, where models must represent structured spatial entities, capture sequential mobility patterns, and produce predictions consistent with real user behavior. We propose Gwhere, an end-to-end industrial framework that integrates semantic identifier (SID) generation with LLM-based generative next POI recommendation. Gwhere first learns discriminative POI SIDs through a contrastive residual-quantization tokenizer that aligns textual, visual, spatial, and collaborative signals. Based on these SIDs, Gwhere adapts LLMs to mobility scenarios via continued pretraining on enriched spatio-temporal corpora, supervised fine-tuning, and Exposure-Aware Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (EAKTO), a reinforcement learning objective for behavioral preference alignment. Experiments on public datasets and Amap's large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of Gwhere. The system has been deployed in Amap's homepage service under high-concurrency and low-latency constraints. Long-term online A/B tests show improvements of 5.83% in P-CTR and 6.20% in U-CTR over the production baseline. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/alibaba/SimCIT.
papers.summary: Gwhere是阿里巴巴高德地图提出的端到端工业级生成式下一兴趣点（POI）推荐框架，旨在解决生成式检索在工业场景中面临的token分配冗余/冲突以及异构信号融合不足等问题。该框架首先通过对比残差量化分词器学习判别性POI语义ID（SID），该分词器对齐文本、视觉、空间和协同信号；然后基于SID，通过丰富时空语料上的持续预训练、监督微调和暴露感知的Kahneman-Tversky优化（EAKTO）将LLM适配到移动场景。在公共数据集和高德大规模工业数据集上的实验验证了有效性，系统已部署在高德首页服务中，长期在线A/B测试显示P-CTR提升5.83%，U-CTR提升6.20%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Gwhere通过语义ID生成和LLM微调，实现了工业级生成式POI推荐，显著提升线上点击率。
papers.core_method: Gwhere包含两个核心组件：1）对比残差量化分词器，学习融合多模态信号的POI语义ID；2）基于LLM的生成式推荐，通过持续预训练、监督微调和EAKTO对齐用户行为偏好。
innovation_points: 提出对比残差量化分词器，生成判别性语义ID，解决token分配冗余和冲突问题
将LLM适配到移动场景，通过持续预训练和EAKTO对齐行为偏好
在工业级高并发低延迟环境下成功部署，验证了生成式推荐的实用性
experiment_results: 公共数据集和高德工业数据集上，Gwhere优于基线模型
长期在线A/B测试显示P-CTR提升5.83%，U-CTR提升6.20%
limitations: 依赖高质量的多模态数据，数据缺失可能影响SID质量
LLM推理成本较高，需优化以满足低延迟要求
EAKTO的奖励模型设计可能需针对不同场景调整
papers.practical_value: Gwhere已部署在高德首页，证明了生成式推荐在真实工业场景中的可行性，为其他地图或基于位置的推荐系统提供了参考。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究解决了生成式推荐在工业落地中的关键挑战，展示了LLM在结构化空间实体建模中的潜力，对推荐系统领域具有重要启发。

papers.title: Prompt Generation Technical Report
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval has become an increasingly adopted paradigm for industrial search, recommendation, and advertising systems, delivering significant online gains. Most existing work combines user behavior sequences with large language models (LLMs) to model user preferences. In practice, feature engineering remains critical to model effectiveness, yet its complexity slows offline iteration and makes online deployment heavy and hard to reuse, all under tight online latency budgets. The root cause is a tight coupling between feature-processing logic and model architecture, where every feature change touches the training and serving code and resists reuse across scenarios. To break this coupling, we present Prompt Generation (PG), a high-level tokenizer and configuration-driven framework that decouples feature-processing logic from model architecture through two declarative JSON files, which serve as the single source of truth for both offline training and online serving, ensuring feature consistency across the two stages. Organizing features under four types with three composable processing components to assemble and compress heterogeneous features, PG delivers acceleration at three levels: (1)fast training iteration: feature experiments require only configuration changes, with built-in token compression for ultra-long sequences; (2)fast deployment: a new scenario only needs to conform to the PG schema and plug into a universal pipeline, with no scenario-specific engineering; (3)fast online inference: engine applies unified optimizations over the standardized configuration, reducing PG's overhead to a negligible level. PG has been deployed on Taobao Search with statistically significant online A/B uplifts of +0.47% in transaction count and +0.51% in GMV, and has been applied across multiple Taobao search and recommendation teams as the iteration framework for generative retrieval.
papers.summary: 生成式检索已成为工业搜索、推荐和广告系统的重要范式，但现有方法将用户行为序列与大型语言模型结合时，特征工程与模型架构紧密耦合，导致离线迭代慢、在线部署重且难以复用。本文提出Prompt Generation（PG），一个高层分词器和配置驱动框架，通过两个声明式JSON文件解耦特征处理逻辑与模型架构，作为离线训练和在线服务的唯一事实来源，确保特征一致性。PG将特征组织为四种类型，使用三个可组合处理组件进行组装和压缩，实现三级加速：快速训练迭代（仅需配置变更，内置超长序列压缩）、快速部署（新场景只需符合PG模式并接入通用管道）、快速在线推理（引擎统一优化，开销可忽略）。PG已在淘宝搜索部署，取得交易数+0.47%和GMV+0.51%的显著线上提升，并被多个搜索和推荐团队采用。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PG通过配置驱动的JSON文件解耦特征与模型，实现生成式检索的快速迭代、部署和推理，并在淘宝搜索获得显著线上收益。
papers.core_method: PG框架：定义两种JSON配置（特征模式和模型模式），将特征分为四类（用户、物品、上下文、交互），通过三个可组合组件（编码器、聚合器、压缩器）处理特征，生成离散token序列供LLM使用。配置作为单一事实来源，驱动离线训练和在线服务，实现特征一致性。
innovation_points: 提出配置驱动的特征处理框架，解耦特征逻辑与模型架构，降低工程复杂度。
设计四类特征和三个可组合组件，支持灵活组装和压缩超长序列。
实现三级加速：训练迭代仅需配置变更，部署无需场景特定工程，推理通过统一优化降低开销。
在淘宝搜索大规模部署，验证了框架的实用性和线上价值。
experiment_results: 淘宝搜索线上A/B测试：交易数提升+0.47%，GMV提升+0.51%，统计显著。
框架已应用于多个淘宝搜索和推荐团队，作为生成式检索的迭代框架。
未提供离线实验数据，如训练时间、推理延迟等具体数值。
limitations: 依赖LLM的生成能力，可能受限于模型规模和推理成本。
配置驱动的灵活性可能增加初期学习成本。
未详细讨论与其他生成式检索方法的对比实验。
papers.practical_value: PG框架显著降低了生成式检索系统的工程复杂度，使特征实验只需修改配置，新场景可快速接入，同时在线推理开销可忽略。已在淘宝搜索产生实际GMV提升，适合工业界大规模部署。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文解决了生成式检索在工业落地中的关键工程瓶颈——特征与模型耦合问题，提供了可复用的配置驱动方案，并展示了真实业务场景中的显著收益，对工业界和学术界均有重要参考价值。

papers.title: FlashTrie: A GPU-Accelerated Constrained Beam Search for Generative Retrieval
papers.abstract: Constrained decoding is essential in generative retrieval, where document identifiers generated directly from a query must exactly match a predefined library of valid IDs. At scale, decoding is often constrained using a trie with beam search but most implementations run on CPU. Limited parallelism then makes trie traversal and candidate validation a serving bottleneck as beam width grows. We present FlashTrie, which addresses this limitation by optimizing constrained beam search on GPUs. It introduces an integer-aware succinct trie layout that uses bit compression to reduce memory footprint while keeping the full index in GPU high-bandwidth memory reducing memory stalls, and a cooperative CUDA kernel that performs beam expansion, validation, and pruning entirely on-device without per-step host orchestration. It further replaces CPU-style irregular lookup and heap maintenance with GPU-aware parallel primitives, improving warp utilization and reducing divergence. Together, these designs significantly reduce decoding latency and increase throughput while preserving retrieval quality. On a library of 800M keywords with beam widths up to 1000, FlashTrie reduces trie-search latency to under 3 ms, achieving up to 24x speedup over a highly optimized multi-threaded CPU baseline. These improvements enable FlashTrie to scale beam sizes by up to 5x in latency-critical applications such as sponsored search. In a large-scale online A/B experiment on a popular commercial search engine, it delivers a statistically significant +0.71% revenue lift, enabling real-time constrained decoding at a scale previously feasible only offline. The FlashTrie code will be publicly released after the review process.
papers.summary: FlashTrie提出了一种面向生成式检索的GPU加速约束波束搜索方法。生成式检索中，模型需直接生成与预定义文档标识符库精确匹配的ID，通常使用基于trie的约束解码，但现有实现多在CPU上运行，导致波束宽度增大时成为服务瓶颈。FlashTrie通过整数感知的紧凑trie布局（位压缩）将完整索引驻留于GPU高带宽内存，减少内存停顿；并设计协作式CUDA内核，在设备端完成波束扩展、验证和剪枝，无需主机逐步骤协调。同时，用GPU并行原语替代CPU式不规则查找和堆维护，提升warp利用率并减少发散。在800M关键词库、波束宽度达1000时，trie搜索延迟降至3毫秒以下，相比多线程CPU基线实现最高24倍加速，并支持波束规模扩大5倍。在大型商业搜索引擎的在线A/B实验中，实现了统计显著的+0.71%收入提升，使实时约束解码达到此前仅离线可行的规模。代码将在评审后公开。
papers.one_line_takeaway: FlashTrie通过GPU优化的紧凑trie布局和协作内核，将生成式检索的约束波束搜索延迟降低至毫秒级，并带来显著在线收益。
papers.core_method: FlashTrie的核心方法包括：1) 整数感知的紧凑trie布局，利用位压缩减少内存占用，使完整索引驻留于GPU高带宽内存；2) 协作式CUDA内核，在设备端完成波束扩展、验证和剪枝，消除主机逐步骤协调；3) 用GPU并行原语替代CPU式不规则查找和堆维护，提升warp利用率并减少发散。
innovation_points: 提出整数感知的紧凑trie布局，通过位压缩显著降低内存占用，使大规模索引可完全驻留于GPU高带宽内存。
设计协作式CUDA内核，实现波束扩展、验证和剪枝的全设备端处理，避免主机-设备间频繁通信。
用GPU并行原语替代CPU式堆维护和查找，改善warp利用率并减少线程发散。
experiment_results: 在800M关键词库、波束宽度达1000时，trie搜索延迟降至3毫秒以下，相比多线程CPU基线实现最高24倍加速。
支持波束规模扩大5倍，适用于延迟敏感场景如赞助搜索。
在大型商业搜索引擎的在线A/B实验中，实现统计显著的+0.71%收入提升。
limitations: 论文未提供与GPU上其他约束解码方法的对比，如基于GPU的beam search实现。
未讨论内存占用与波束宽度、关键词库大小的扩展性关系，可能受限于GPU内存容量。
在线实验仅报告收入提升，未提供检索质量指标（如NDCG）的详细变化。
papers.practical_value: FlashTrie使生成式检索的约束解码能够实时运行，支持更大波束宽度，提升检索质量，并在商业搜索引擎中带来收入增长。其GPU优化设计可直接应用于工业级检索系统，降低延迟和成本。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文解决了生成式检索中约束解码的工程瓶颈，展示了GPU优化在推理系统中的关键作用。其方法具有通用性，可推广到其他需要约束解码的生成任务，为大规模部署生成式模型提供了实践指导。

papers.title: Recommendation as Generation: Unifying Personalized Video Generation and Recommendation at Industrial Scale
papers.abstract: Traditional short-video recommendation systems match user interest to a fixed pool of pre-produced videos, which limits their ability to capture fine-grained and dynamic preferences. We propose Recommendation-as-Generation (RaG), a new paradigm that generates personalized videos on demand from inferred user interest. Our framework unifies generative recommendation and video generation through shared semantic IDs (SIDs), which disentangle video representation into content semantics and creative style semantics, enabling both fine-grained modeling of user interest and controllable generation of interest-aligned videos. We further develop Video Generation Agents (VGAs) that are conditioned on inferred SIDs to drive hierarchical planning and refinement for video creation, including visual composition, audio alignment, and artistic effect enhancement. To optimize the framework, we effectively introduce a synergistic cross-domain reward learning mechanism that jointly enforces interest alignment, user feedback, and video quality assessment. We deploy RaG on an industrial-scale platform with over 400 million daily active users and evaluate it in a revenue-critical advertising scenario. Online A/B tests show up to 1.87% ad revenue improvement compared to a strong production GRM baseline, demonstrating its effectiveness in driving further revenue gains beyond generative recommendation. Our results highlight a closed-loop generative system as a promising paradigm for integrating personalized video generation into recommendation.
papers.summary: 本文提出推荐即生成（RaG）范式，将个性化视频生成与推荐系统统一于工业规模平台。传统短视频推荐仅匹配预生成视频，难以捕捉细粒度动态偏好。RaG通过共享语义ID（SIDs）解耦视频内容语义与创意风格语义，实现用户兴趣精细建模与可控视频生成。系统采用视频生成智能体（VGAs），基于推断的SIDs进行分层规划与细化，涵盖视觉构图、音频对齐和艺术效果增强。优化上引入跨域奖励学习机制，联合强化兴趣对齐、用户反馈与视频质量评估。在日活超4亿的工业平台广告场景中部署，在线A/B测试显示广告收入提升1.87%，优于强生产基线GRM，验证了闭环生成系统的有效性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RaG通过共享语义ID统一生成式推荐与视频生成，在工业规模广告场景中显著提升收入，展示了闭环生成系统的潜力。
papers.core_method: 共享语义ID（SIDs）解耦视频内容与风格，视频生成智能体（VGAs）基于SIDs分层规划生成，跨域奖励学习联合优化兴趣对齐、用户反馈与视频质量。
innovation_points: 提出RaG范式，将推荐从匹配固定视频池转变为按需生成个性化视频。
引入共享语义ID（SIDs），统一生成式推荐与视频生成，实现可控生成。
开发视频生成智能体（VGAs），支持分层规划与多维度细化。
设计跨域奖励学习机制，协同优化兴趣对齐、用户反馈与视频质量。
experiment_results: 在线A/B测试显示广告收入提升1.87%，相比强生产GRM基线。
系统部署于日活超4亿的工业平台，验证了可扩展性。
limitations: 论文未提供离线评估细节，如生成视频质量的具体指标。
依赖大规模基础设施，可能不适用于中小型平台。
未讨论生成视频的伦理与安全风险。
papers.practical_value: RaG在真实广告场景中带来显著收入提升，为推荐系统与内容生成的融合提供了可落地方案，对短视频平台具有直接商业价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文首次在工业规模验证了生成式推荐与视频生成的闭环，突破了传统推荐边界，为未来个性化内容生成提供了新范式，值得关注其技术架构与工程实现。

papers.title: Adaptive Loss Balancing for Noise-Robust GRPO in Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) presents a promising avenue for enhancing generative recommendation beyond supervised imitation, leveraging reward signals to guide policy improvement. However, its efficacy is critically contingent on the trustworthiness of the reward model for the samples it evaluates. In practice, production rankers, the widely adopted reward models, are trained on exposure-biased logs, leading to sample-dependent inaccuracies that violate this assumption. Our stratified analysis uncovers a consistent pattern: reward guidance is most beneficial when the policy exhibits uncertainty and the ranker can effectively discriminate the ground-truth item from rollout negatives. On other samples, the reward signal is either negligible or detrimental, highlighting the risk of uniform RL application. To address such an issue, we introduce AdaGRPO, a novel framework that treats reward-guided optimization as selective admission rather than uniform pressure. Training is anchored in supervised negative log-likelihood, while the GRPO objective is gated by a binary, per-sample clip determined by two rollout diagnostics: policy-side difficulty and reward discriminability. Instances failing either diagnostic default to pure supervision, ensuring stability and mitigating the amplification of noisy gradients. We validate AdaGRPO on a large-scale e-commerce dataset. At the best intermediate checkpoint, it elevates HR@10 from 11.01% to 12.18% while constraining hallucination below 0.22%, and maintains robustness at the final checkpoint (HR@10 11.63%, hallucination 0.27%), outperforming fixed NLL--GRPO mixtures across the retrieval--validity frontier. In production A/B tests, AdaGRPO achieves statistically significant gains in click-through rate and dwell time, confirming its practical utility.
papers.summary: 本文针对生成式推荐中强化学习（RL）因奖励模型不可靠而失效的问题，提出AdaGRPO框架。通过分层分析发现，奖励引导仅在策略不确定且排序器能有效区分真实项与负样本时有益，否则有害。AdaGRPO以监督负对数似然（NLL）为锚，用策略难度和奖励可区分性两个诊断指标决定每个样本是否应用GRPO目标，不满足条件的样本仅用监督学习。在大型电商数据集上，最佳中间检查点HR@10从11.01%提升至12.18%，幻觉率低于0.22%；最终检查点HR@10为11.63%，幻觉率0.27%，优于固定NLL-GRPO混合。线上A/B测试显示点击率和停留时间显著提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AdaGRPO通过选择性应用GRPO，仅在奖励可靠时使用强化学习，显著提升生成式推荐的检索准确性和有效性。
papers.core_method: AdaGRPO框架：以监督NLL为训练基础，对每个样本计算两个诊断指标（策略侧难度和奖励可区分性），据此决定是否应用GRPO目标。若任一指标不达标，则跳过GRPO，仅用监督损失，从而避免噪声梯度放大。
innovation_points: 提出分层分析揭示奖励引导的适用条件：仅在策略不确定且排序器可区分时有效。
设计基于样本的自适应门控机制，将GRPO视为选择性准入而非统一压力。
在离线评估和线上A/B测试中验证了方法在检索-有效性前沿上的优势。
experiment_results: 离线：最佳中间检查点HR@10从11.01%提升至12.18%，幻觉率低于0.22%；最终检查点HR@10为11.63%，幻觉率0.27%。
线上A/B测试：点击率和停留时间有统计显著提升。
limitations: 依赖两个诊断指标的计算，可能增加训练开销。
未在多种数据集上验证，泛化性未知。
未提供与最新RLHF方法的全面对比。
papers.practical_value: 为生成式推荐系统提供了一种稳健的RL训练策略，在真实电商场景中显著提升点击率和用户停留时间，同时控制幻觉，可直接应用于生产环境。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文直面RL在推荐中奖励模型不可靠的核心问题，提出自适应门控机制，为生成式推荐中的RL应用提供了新思路，且离线在线均验证有效，具有重要工程参考价值。

papers.title: Gryphon: A Unified Architecture for Semantic-ID Generation and Item-Level Scoring in Industrial Recommendations
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) has become a scalable approach to candidate generation: each item is assigned a short hierarchical token sequence called a Semantic ID (SID), and the next item's SID is decoded autoregressively. A practical limitation is that the decoder's beam search optimizes the likelihood of token sequences, not the relevance of the underlying items. These objectives diverge when sequence likelihood is poorly calibrated due to beam search error accumulation, and when several items collapse onto a single SID and receive identical scores. We introduce Gryphon, an encoder-decoder generative recommendation architecture that adds a jointly trained item-level scoring component alongside SID generation, reusing the encoder's user representation computed in a single forward pass. Instead of ranking SIDs by accumulated token likelihood, Gryphon resolves each generated SID to its concrete items and re-scores those items directly, which sidesteps miscalibrated sequence scores and separates items that collide on the same identifier. On an industrial music service, with item-level scoring trained under a next-item-prediction objective, Gryphon attains the highest item-level Recall@1000, above the strongest baselines (+3.7% over vanilla GR and +2.5% over collision-resolved GR) at comparable parameter count and latency. Gryphon's item-level ranking also surpasses its beam-likelihood ranking of the same candidates (+4.2% gain), demonstrating the benefit of item-level scoring in GR. Deployed as the sole candidate source in a 7-day A/B test, Gryphon produced no statistically significant change in total listening time (+0.25%) while replacing a pipeline of more than 15 candidate generators and a separate preranking stage, substantially simplifying the candidate-generation system.
papers.summary: Gryphon提出了一种统一的编码器-解码器生成式推荐架构，在工业推荐系统中同时进行语义ID生成和物品级评分。针对生成式检索中解码器束搜索优化序列似然而非物品相关性的问题，以及多个物品共享同一语义ID导致评分相同的问题，Gryphon在生成语义ID的同时，利用编码器单次前向计算得到的用户表示，对生成的语义ID解析出的具体物品进行直接重评分。在工业音乐服务上，采用下一项预测目标训练物品级评分，Gryphon在物品级Recall@1000上达到最高，比最强基线（vanilla GR和collision-resolved GR）分别提升3.7%和2.5%，参数和延迟相当。Gryphon的物品级排序比同一候选集的束似然排序提升4.2%。在7天A/B测试中，作为唯一候选源，Gryphon替代了超过15个候选生成器和独立预排序阶段，总收听时间无显著变化（+0.25%），大幅简化了候选生成系统。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Gryphon通过联合训练物品级评分组件，直接对生成的语义ID解析出的物品进行重排序，解决了生成式推荐中序列似然与物品相关性目标不一致及语义ID碰撞问题，在工业规模上提升了召回率并简化了系统。
papers.core_method: Gryphon采用编码器-解码器架构，编码器生成用户表示，解码器自回归生成语义ID序列。在训练时，除了标准的序列生成损失，还联合训练一个物品级评分头，该评分头复用编码器的用户表示，对每个生成的语义ID对应的具体物品进行评分。推理时，解码器通过束搜索生成候选语义ID，然后解析出所有对应物品，用物品级评分头重新排序，而不是使用束搜索的累积似然。
innovation_points: 提出联合训练的物品级评分组件，与语义ID生成共享编码器表示，实现单次前向计算。
推理时直接对解析出的物品进行重评分，避免序列似然校准不良和束搜索误差累积。
解决语义ID碰撞问题，使共享同一ID的物品获得不同分数。
在工业规模上验证，可替代多候选生成器和预排序阶段，简化系统架构。
experiment_results: 物品级Recall@1000：Gryphon比vanilla GR提升3.7%，比collision-resolved GR提升2.5%，参数和延迟相当。
Gryphon的物品级排序比同一候选集的束似然排序提升4.2%。
7天A/B测试：作为唯一候选源，总收听时间变化+0.25%，无统计显著差异，替代了15+候选生成器和预排序阶段。
limitations: 物品级评分仅针对解码器生成的候选集，可能受限于束搜索的候选质量。
实验仅在音乐服务场景验证，其他领域泛化性未知。
A/B测试中总收听时间无显著提升，可能未充分体现推荐质量改进。
papers.practical_value: Gryphon在工业推荐系统中可直接部署，替代复杂的多候选生成器和预排序流水线，简化系统维护和计算成本，同时保持或略微提升核心业务指标（如收听时间），为生成式推荐在真实场景中的落地提供了可行方案。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对生成式推荐的核心缺陷（序列似然与物品相关性目标不一致、语义ID碰撞）提出了实用的解决方案，并在工业规模上验证了其有效性，对生成式推荐在工业界的应用具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: SSRLive: Live Streaming Recommendation with Dynamic Semantic ID
papers.abstract: Live streaming has emerged as one of the fastest-growing forms of online media, enabling instant content broadcasting and real-time engagement between users and streamers. Despite the effectiveness of existing recommendation algorithms in this domain, they often suffer from limited utilization of computational resources, with low FLOPs that hinder further performance enhancement. Generative recommendation techniques, which have gained traction in various industrial tasks, offer a promising avenue for improving live streaming recommendations. However, directly applying generative methods to live streaming is non-trivial due to two major challenges: (1) static semantic IDs (SIDs) cannot reflect the rapidly changing nature of live room content; and (2) generative pipelines generally do not incorporate user--streamer interaction signals (e.g., likes, orders), which are critical for modeling user intent toward both the streamer and showcased products. To address these challenges, we introduce SSRLive: Dynamic Semantic ID-guided Streaming Recommendation for Live platforms. The proposed framework integrates a generative module and a discriminative module in a unified architecture. The generative component employs an encoder-decoder design to produce both static and dynamic SIDs, enabling timely representation of live room content while leveraging multimodal information. The discriminative component refines task-specific representations by combining SIDs with user features, augments them with user-streamer interaction data, and performs multi-task predictions. Online A/B tests in real-world deployment demonstrate tangible benefits: watch time (+3.38%), GMV (+0.72%), follower growth (+3.12%), and interaction volume (+2.92%). These improvements highlight the effectiveness and business value of SSRLive, which is now fully deployed, serving hundreds of millions of active users.
papers.summary: SSRLive针对直播推荐中静态语义ID无法反映直播间内容动态变化、以及生成式推荐未充分利用用户与主播交互信号的问题，提出了一种动态语义ID引导的直播推荐框架。该框架统一了生成式与判别式模块：生成模块采用编码器-解码器结构，结合多模态信息生成静态和动态语义ID，以实时表征直播间内容；判别模块将语义ID与用户特征结合，并融入用户-主播交互数据，进行多任务预测。在线A/B测试显示，该方法在观看时长、GMV、粉丝增长和互动量上分别提升3.38%、0.72%、3.12%和2.92%，已全面部署服务数亿活跃用户。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SSRLive通过动态语义ID和生成-判别统一架构，显著提升直播推荐的业务指标，验证了生成式推荐在动态场景中的可行性。
papers.core_method: 提出SSRLive框架，包含生成模块（编码器-解码器生成静态和动态语义ID，利用多模态信息）和判别模块（融合语义ID与用户特征，加入用户-主播交互信号，进行多任务预测）。
innovation_points: 提出动态语义ID机制，解决直播内容快速变化下静态ID失效的问题。
在生成式推荐中引入用户-主播交互信号（如点赞、订单），增强用户意图建模。
统一生成式与判别式模块，兼顾内容表征和任务优化。
experiment_results: 在线A/B测试显示：观看时长提升3.38%，GMV提升0.72%，粉丝增长提升3.12%，互动量提升2.92%。
系统已全面部署，服务数亿活跃用户。
limitations: 论文未提供离线实验数据或消融研究细节。
动态语义ID的更新频率和计算开销未明确说明。
交互信号的引入可能增加数据稀疏性问题。
papers.practical_value: SSRLive已在真实直播平台部署，显著提升核心业务指标，为直播推荐系统提供了可落地的生成式推荐方案，尤其适用于内容动态变化和强交互场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究首次将动态语义ID应用于直播推荐，解决了生成式推荐在实时场景中的关键挑战，并通过大规模在线实验验证了业务价值，对生成式推荐在工业界的应用具有重要参考意义。

papers.title: LEAP: Supercharging LLMs for Formal Mathematics with Agentic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong informal mathematical reasoning but struggle to generate mechanically verifiable proofs in formal languages like Lean. We present LEAP, an agentic framework that enables general-purpose foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance on automated formal theorem proving. LEAP leverages foundation model capabilities, such as informal reasoning, instruction following, and iterative self-refinement. By decomposing complex problems into smaller units, the system bridges formal proof construction with informal blueprints through continuous interaction with the Lean compiler. To provide a rigorous evaluation beyond increasingly saturated benchmarks, we introduce Lean-IMO-Bench, a benchmark of IMO-style problems formalized in Lean, with short statements yet highly non-routine and multi-step proofs across a wide range of difficulty levels. Empirically, on the latest 2025 Putnam Competition, an annual mathematics competition for undergraduate students in North America, LEAP solves all 12 problems, matching recent breakthroughs by frontier formal mathematical models. On Lean-IMO-Bench, LEAP boosts the one-shot formal solve rate of general-purpose LLMs from below 10% to 70%, notably surpassing the 48% benchmark set by a specialized, gold-medal-caliber IMO system. Furthermore, we demonstrate LEAP's research-level utility by autonomously formalizing complex proofs for open combinatorial challenges, including a verified proof for a key subproblem in Knuth's Hamiltonian decomposition of even-order Cayley graphs.
papers.summary: LEAP是一个智能体框架，旨在提升通用大语言模型在形式化数学定理证明中的表现。传统LLM在非正式数学推理上表现良好，但难以生成Lean等语言中可机械验证的证明。LEAP通过将复杂问题分解为更小的单元，并利用基础模型的非正式推理、指令遵循和迭代自我修正能力，与Lean编译器持续交互，桥接形式化证明构建与非正式蓝图。为严格评估，作者引入了Lean-IMO-Bench基准，包含IMO风格问题，语句简短但证明高度非例行且多步骤。实验表明，在2025年Putnam竞赛中，LEAP解决了全部12个问题，匹配前沿专用模型；在Lean-IMO-Bench上，将通用LLM的一次性形式化解决率从低于10%提升至70%，超过专业IMO系统的48%。此外，LEAP还自主形式化了Knuth关于偶数阶Cayley图哈密顿分解的关键子问题的验证证明，展示了研究级实用性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: LEAP通过智能体框架分解问题并迭代交互，显著提升通用LLM在形式化定理证明上的能力，达到甚至超越专用系统。
papers.core_method: LEAP采用智能体框架，将复杂形式化证明任务分解为多个子问题，利用基础LLM的非正式推理和指令遵循能力生成非正式蓝图，然后通过持续与Lean编译器交互进行迭代自我修正，逐步构建可验证的形式化证明。
innovation_points: 提出智能体框架LEAP，使通用基础模型无需专门训练即可在形式化定理证明上达到SOTA。
引入Lean-IMO-Bench基准，包含IMO风格问题，难度高且非例行，用于更严格的评估。
在Putnam竞赛和Lean-IMO-Bench上超越专用系统，并成功形式化开放组合问题的关键子证明。
experiment_results: 在2025年Putnam竞赛中，LEAP解决了全部12个问题，匹配前沿形式化数学模型的突破。
在Lean-IMO-Bench上，LEAP将通用LLM的一次性形式化解决率从低于10%提升至70%，超过专业IMO系统的48%。
LEAP自主形式化了Knuth关于偶数阶Cayley图哈密顿分解的关键子问题的验证证明。
limitations: LEAP依赖基础模型的非正式推理能力，若模型本身推理能力不足，性能可能受限。
框架需要大量与Lean编译器的交互，计算成本较高。
Lean-IMO-Bench规模有限，可能无法完全覆盖所有数学领域。
papers.practical_value: LEAP展示了通用LLM在形式化数学中的潜力，可辅助数学家验证复杂证明，降低形式化门槛，加速数学研究。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究突破性地让通用LLM在形式化定理证明上超越专用系统，为AI for Math提供了新范式，并引入更严格的基准，推动领域发展。

papers.title: MiniMax M3
papers.abstract: MiniMax-M3 is a native multimodal model with 1M context. It has ~428B parameters and ~23B activated parameters.
papers.summary: MiniMax-M3是MiniMax公司发布的原生多模态大模型，拥有约4280亿总参数和230亿激活参数，支持100万token的上下文窗口。该模型采用MoE架构，通过稀疏激活实现高效推理，同时原生支持文本、图像、音频等多种模态输入。官方技术发布重点展示了其在长上下文理解、多模态融合和推理效率方面的优势，但未提供详细的训练数据、对齐方法或基准测试结果。该模型旨在解决企业级应用中长文档处理、多模态数据理解和实时交互等场景的挑战，体现了MiniMax在基座模型技术上的最新进展。
papers.one_line_takeaway: MiniMax-M3是一款428B总参数、23B激活参数的原生多模态MoE模型，支持1M上下文，但官方未披露详细技术细节和实验数据。
papers.core_method: 采用MoE（混合专家）架构，总参数428B，激活参数23B，实现稀疏激活；原生多模态设计，统一处理文本、图像、音频；支持1M token长上下文。
innovation_points: 原生多模态架构，而非后期拼接，实现跨模态统一表示
MoE架构在保持大模型能力的同时降低推理成本，激活参数仅占总参数约5%
1M上下文窗口，支持超长文档和多轮对话场景
experiment_results: 官方未提供具体基准测试数据，仅宣称模型在长上下文和多模态任务上表现优异
未披露训练数据规模、计算资源或对齐方法
limitations: 官方技术发布缺乏详细的技术报告和实验数据，难以独立验证性能
激活参数23B虽低，但总参数428B仍需要较高显存，部署成本不低
未说明多模态融合的具体机制和训练策略
papers.practical_value: 对于企业用户，MiniMax-M3的1M上下文和原生多模态能力可应用于长文档分析、视频理解、智能客服等场景，MoE架构有助于降低推理成本，适合大规模部署。
papers.why_it_matters: 该模型展示了国产大模型在基座架构上的创新，MoE与多模态结合是行业趋势，值得关注其后续技术细节和实际效果。

papers.title: How Far Can Disaggregation Go? A Design-Space Exploration of Attention-FFN Disaggregation for Efficient MoE LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) inference has progressively disaggregated to keep pace with growing model sizes and tight TTFT and TPOT service-level objectives: from chunked-prefill aggregation, to prefill-decode (P/D) disaggregation, and most recently to operator-level Attention-FFN Disaggregation (AFD). This trend is especially important for mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, where memory-bound attention, compute-intensive expert FFNs, and MoE dispatch/combine communication create distinct resource demands. AFD further exposes this heterogeneity by placing attention and MoE-FFN execution on separate GPU groups. Each level of disaggregation deepens the scheduling design space across workload characteristics, resource allocation, and interconnect topology, raising the central question: when does each level actually pay off? We systematically characterize this trade-off for MoE inference across realistic workloads spanning input/output sequence lengths, prefix-KV reuse, and per-user latency constraints. Using chunked-prefill and P/D disaggregation as baselines, we study the benefits and limits of AFD at scale through a framework that fuses on-device kernel measurements with high-fidelity network simulation. Under strict TTFT/TPOT SLOs, AFD sustains around 4k tokens/s of system throughput on DeepSeek-V3.2 across chat, coding, and agentic-coding workloads, where non-AFD deployments are infeasible. We distill concrete takeaways for jointly optimizing throughput and interactivity, including how to partition attention and FFN across GPUs as a function of workload and model architecture, providing design principles for current rack- and cluster-scale deployments as well as future disaggregated AI infrastructure.
papers.summary: 本文系统探索了MoE大模型推理中注意力与FFN算子级解聚（AFD）的设计空间，以应对模型规模增长和TTFT/TPOT严格SLO带来的挑战。相比分块预填充和预填充-解码解聚，AFD将注意力与MoE-FFN分别部署在不同GPU组，进一步暴露资源需求异质性。作者通过融合设备内核测量与高保真网络模拟的框架，在真实工作负载（聊天、编码、智能体编码）下对比不同解聚级别的收益与限制。结果表明，在严格SLO下，AFD在DeepSeek-V3.2上可维持约4k tokens/s的系统吞吐量，而非AFD部署不可行。文章还提炼了根据工作负载和模型架构划分注意力与FFN的实用原则，为当前机架/集群及未来解聚AI基础设施提供设计指导。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 算子级注意力-FFN解聚（AFD）在严格SLO下显著提升MoE推理吞吐，但收益取决于工作负载和资源分配。
papers.core_method: 构建一个融合设备内核测量与高保真网络仿真的框架，系统比较分块预填充、预填充-解码解聚和注意力-FFN解聚（AFD）在MoE推理中的性能，并探索注意力与FFN的GPU划分策略。
innovation_points: 首次系统探索注意力-FFN算子级解聚（AFD）的设计空间，涵盖工作负载特征、资源分配和互连拓扑。
提出融合设备内核测量与网络仿真的评估框架，实现高保真的大规模解聚性能预测。
在DeepSeek-V3.2上验证AFD在严格SLO下维持约4k tokens/s吞吐，而非AFD部署不可行。
提炼出根据工作负载和模型架构划分注意力与FFN的实用设计原则。
experiment_results: 在严格TTFT/TPOT SLO下，AFD在DeepSeek-V3.2上可维持约4k tokens/s的系统吞吐量，覆盖聊天、编码和智能体编码工作负载。
非AFD部署在相同SLO下不可行，表明AFD在特定场景下的必要性。
研究提供了注意力与FFN划分的指导原则，但未给出具体数值对比表。
limitations: 研究基于模拟和内核测量，可能未完全反映真实生产环境的动态变化。
主要聚焦于MoE模型，对密集模型或其他架构的适用性未明确。
未提供详细的成本效益分析，如硬件投入与吞吐提升的量化关系。
papers.practical_value: 为MoE推理服务提供商提供了解聚级别的选择指南，帮助在严格SLO下优化吞吐和交互性，尤其适用于大规模部署和未来AI基础设施规划。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究填补了算子级解聚在MoE推理中的系统研究空白，为设计高效解聚系统提供了实证依据和设计原则，对推动LLM推理基础设施演进具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Stochastic Primal-Dual Decoding for Multiobjective Generative Recommender Systems
papers.abstract: Recent advances in recommender systems (RS) have shown substantial performance gains through generative modelling. In practice, recommendation often involves constructing slates -- ordered lists of items -- that must satisfy multiple objectives beyond relevance, such as constraints defined over item attributes or fairness constraints. Existing multiobjective approaches either rely on post-processing techniques designed for non-generative settings, or incorporate auxiliary objectives directly into model training. The former does not explicitly account for the sequential nature of generative RS, while the latter is often impractical in large-scale systems. We propose a lightweight, inference-time decoding layer that augments autoregressive generative RS to support multiobjective slate generation without modifying or retraining the underlying model. We formulate decoding as an online constrained optimisation problem, where items are selected sequentially, and trade-offs between relevance and auxiliary objectives are adjusted dynamically based on the remaining constraint slack, i.e., how much of each objective remains to be satisfied. This is implemented via a stochastic primal-dual approximation scheme that balances relevance and auxiliary objectives during generation. We provide theoretical guarantees on constraint violation and regret, and evaluate the proposed approach through extensive offline experiments and a large-scale online A/B experiment in a real-world recommender system. Our results show consistent improvements in multiobjective trade-offs, including a +1.8\% gain in the auxiliary objectives achieved at zero cost to user satisfaction.
papers.summary: 本文针对生成式推荐系统（RS）在多目标槽位构建中的挑战，提出了一种轻量级的推理时解码层。现有方法要么依赖非生成式设置的后处理技术，要么将辅助目标直接纳入训练，但前者未考虑生成式RS的序列特性，后者在大规模系统中不实用。本文将解码过程建模为在线约束优化问题，通过随机原始-对偶近似方案，在生成过程中动态调整相关性与辅助目标（如公平性、属性约束）之间的权衡，基于剩余约束松弛度进行决策。理论分析提供了约束违反和遗憾的保证。离线实验和真实推荐系统的大规模在线A/B实验表明，该方法在多目标权衡上持续改进，在用户满意度零损失的情况下，辅助目标提升+1.8%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 提出一种无需重新训练模型的推理时随机原始-对偶解码方法，可动态平衡生成式推荐中的多目标约束，实现零成本辅助目标提升。
papers.core_method: 随机原始-对偶近似解码层：将槽位生成视为在线约束优化，每步选择物品时根据当前约束松弛度调整相关性与辅助目标的权重，通过原始-对偶更新保证约束满足和低遗憾。
innovation_points: 提出推理时解码层，无需修改或重训练底层生成模型，即可支持多目标槽位生成。
将解码形式化为在线约束优化，并采用随机原始-对偶算法动态调整目标权衡。
提供理论保证（约束违反和遗憾界），并验证于真实大规模推荐系统。
experiment_results: 离线实验显示多目标权衡一致改进。
在线A/B实验：辅助目标提升+1.8%，用户满意度零损失。
limitations: 依赖底层生成模型的序列输出，可能不适用于非自回归生成器。
理论保证基于特定假设，实际约束可能更复杂。
未详细讨论计算开销，但声称轻量级。
papers.practical_value: 为生成式推荐系统提供了一种即插即用的多目标控制方案，企业无需重新训练模型即可满足公平性、多样性等业务约束，降低部署成本，并能在线上实现可量化的业务指标提升。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作填补了生成式推荐中多目标解码的空白，将在线优化与生成模型结合，兼顾理论严谨性和工程实用性，为大规模推荐系统提供了新思路。

papers.title: SIREN: Unified Multi-Granularity Semantic Interaction for Multi-Modal Lifelong User Interest Modeling
papers.abstract: Industrial recommender systems increasingly leverage lifelong user behavior histories and rich multi-modal content to capture evolving user preferences. However, effectively integrating multi-modal features into lifelong interest modeling remains challenging due to the inherent misalignment between multi-modal and collaborative spaces. Existing paradigms typically rely on separate modeling of multi-modal sequence and behavior sequence, and late fusion to alleviate the modality gap, which results in coarse-grained multi-modal representation and limited integration. In this paper, we propose SIREN, a unified multi-granularity semantic interaction framework for multi-modal lifelong user interest modeling. In the General Search Unit stage, we introduce two alternative retrieval strategies: multi-modal similarity-based soft retrieval for retrieval effectiveness, and Semantic ID (SemID)-based hard retrieval for efficient industrial serving. For the Exact Search Unit stage, we explicitly incorporate target-aware relevance via coarse similarity buckets and fine-grained prefix-encoded SemIDs, enabling unified interaction with collaborative ID features within the target-conditioned transformer architecture. Extensive experiments on the offline dataset demonstrate that SIREN achieves a state-of-the-art GAUC. Online A/B tests further demonstrate consistent GMV gains across multiple production scenarios, including +2.28% in Weixin Moments, +3.87% in Weixin Official Accounts, and +1.61% in Weixin Channels. From July 2025, SIREN has been fully launched for full-traffic serving in Tencent's advertising platform.
papers.summary: 工业推荐系统日益依赖长期用户行为历史和丰富的多模态内容来捕捉用户偏好的演变。然而，由于多模态空间与协同空间之间的固有错位，将多模态特征有效整合到终身兴趣建模中仍具挑战性。现有范式通常依赖对多模态序列和行为序列的分离建模，并通过后期融合来缓解模态差距，这导致多模态表示粗糙且整合有限。本文提出SIREN，一个用于多模态终身用户兴趣建模的统一多粒度语义交互框架。在通用搜索单元阶段，引入两种可选的检索策略：基于多模态相似性的软检索以提升检索效果，以及基于语义ID（SemID）的硬检索以实现高效工业服务。在精确搜索单元阶段，通过粗粒度相似度桶和细粒度前缀编码的SemID显式融入目标感知相关性，在目标条件Transformer架构内实现与协同ID特征的统一交互。离线实验表明SIREN达到了最先进的GAUC。在线A/B测试进一步证明了在多个生产场景中的一致GMV提升，包括微信朋友圈+2.28%、微信公众号+3.87%和微信视频号+1.61%。自2025年7月起，SIREN已在腾讯广告平台全流量上线。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SIREN通过统一多粒度语义交互框架，结合软检索和基于语义ID的硬检索，有效解决了多模态终身兴趣建模中的模态错位问题，并在腾讯广告平台取得显著在线收益。
papers.core_method: SIREN框架包含两个阶段：通用搜索单元和精确搜索单元。通用搜索单元提供两种检索策略：多模态相似性软检索（利用多模态嵌入计算相似度）和基于语义ID的硬检索（将多模态内容映射为离散语义ID，支持高效索引）。精确搜索单元通过粗粒度相似度桶和细粒度前缀编码的SemID，在目标条件Transformer中融合目标感知相关性和协同ID特征，实现统一交互。
innovation_points: 提出统一多粒度语义交互框架，将多模态特征与协同特征在终身兴趣建模中深度融合，而非后期融合。
设计双检索策略：软检索保证效果，硬检索（基于SemID）满足工业级服务效率。
在精确搜索单元中引入粗粒度相似度桶和细粒度前缀编码SemID，实现目标感知的多粒度交互。
experiment_results: 离线数据集上达到最先进的GAUC。
在线A/B测试中，微信朋友圈GMV提升+2.28%，微信公众号+3.87%，微信视频号+1.61%。
自2025年7月起全流量上线腾讯广告平台。
limitations: 论文未提供离线GAUC的具体数值，仅称最先进。
未详细讨论SemID的生成细节及其对多模态内容的覆盖范围。
未分析框架在不同规模数据或不同模态组合下的鲁棒性。
papers.practical_value: SIREN已在腾讯广告平台全流量部署，显著提升多个业务场景的GMV，证明了其在实际工业推荐系统中的有效性和可落地性。其基于SemID的硬检索策略为多模态推荐提供了高效的工程解决方案。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对多模态终身兴趣建模中的模态错位问题，提出了一种统一交互框架，并在真实工业场景中验证了显著收益。对于推荐系统研究者和工程师，SIREN提供了从模型设计到工程部署的完整案例，特别是语义ID在检索中的应用，具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: From Head to Tail: Asymmetric Knowledge Transfer in Long-tail Recommendation with Generative Semantic IDs
papers.abstract: Long-tail recommendation in real-world e-commerce platforms remains challenging due to severe data imbalance. Existing methods often struggle to combine content-based multimodal features with collaborative signals. Many of these methods also ignore an important asymmetry in knowledge transfer between head and tail IDs: noisy signals from tail IDs can hurt representation learning for head IDs. This paper presents AKT-Rec, a framework for Asymmetric Knowledge Transfer in long-tail Recommendation that uses LLM-generated semantic IDs. AKT-Rec uses Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) with supervised fine-tuning to align content representations with collaborative information for both items and users, producing semantic representations. It then discretizes these representations into semantic IDs with a Residual-Quantized VAE (RQ-VAE), which yields semantic clusters of similar entities. AKT-Rec has two main components: (1) Cluster-Guided Adaptive Embedding, which decomposes each ID representation into a cluster-level embedding that captures shared semantics and an individual embedding. Through an asymmetric contrastive objective and an activity-aware gating mechanism, this module directs knowledge transfer from head to tail IDs. (2) Hierarchical Feature Aggregation, which builds parallel feature views and adaptively fuses them to optimize predictions for samples with varying activity levels. Extensive experiments on a large-scale industrial dataset and online A/B testing on the Alibaba Tmall platform demonstrate the effectiveness of AKT-Rec. AKT-Rec improves offline performance by 0.35% in AUC and 1.53% in GAUC, outperforming several competitive baselines. In online A/B testing, AKT-Rec achieves a 2.76% increase in CTR and a 3.47% increase in GMV, validating its utility in real-world production environments.
papers.summary: 针对真实电商平台中长尾推荐面临的数据严重不平衡问题，现有方法难以有效结合多模态内容特征与协同信号，且忽略了头尾ID间知识迁移的不对称性（尾部噪声会损害头部表示学习）。本文提出AKT-Rec框架，利用多模态大模型（MLLM）进行监督微调，将内容表示与协同信息对齐，生成语义表示，并通过残差量化VAE（RQ-VAE）离散化为语义ID。框架包含两个核心组件：簇引导自适应嵌入（分解为簇级和个体嵌入，通过非对称对比学习和活动感知门控实现头到尾的知识迁移）和层次特征聚合（构建并行特征视图并自适应融合）。在阿里巴巴天猫平台的大规模工业数据集和在线A/B测试中，AKT-Rec离线AUC提升0.35%、GAUC提升1.53%，在线CTR提升2.76%、GMV提升3.47%，验证了其实际生产环境中的有效性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AKT-Rec通过LLM生成的语义ID和头尾非对称知识迁移，有效提升长尾推荐性能，并在工业场景中验证了显著业务价值。
papers.core_method: AKT-Rec框架：1) 使用多模态大模型（MLLM）监督微调对齐内容与协同信息，生成语义表示；2) 通过RQ-VAE将语义表示离散化为语义ID；3) 簇引导自适应嵌入模块，将ID表示分解为簇级和个体嵌入，采用非对称对比学习和活动感知门控机制，实现从头到尾的知识迁移；4) 层次特征聚合模块，构建并行特征视图并自适应融合，优化不同活跃度样本的预测。
innovation_points: 首次提出利用LLM生成的语义ID进行长尾推荐，并显式建模头尾ID间知识迁移的非对称性。
设计簇引导自适应嵌入，通过非对称对比学习和活动感知门控，实现头到尾的定向知识迁移，避免尾部噪声干扰头部。
提出层次特征聚合，自适应融合多视图特征，适应不同活跃度样本。
在工业级数据集和在线A/B测试中验证了方法的有效性，展示了实际业务价值。
experiment_results: 离线实验：AUC提升0.35%，GAUC提升1.53%，优于多个竞争基线。
在线A/B测试（天猫平台）：CTR提升2.76%，GMV提升3.47%。
未提供消融实验或详细统计显著性数据。
limitations: 依赖多模态LLM和RQ-VAE，计算成本较高，可能限制在资源受限场景的部署。
语义ID的生成质量受LLM能力影响，可能引入额外偏差。
实验仅基于单一工业数据集（天猫），泛化性需进一步验证。
papers.practical_value: AKT-Rec在真实电商平台（天猫）上显著提升CTR和GMV，直接证明了其在生产环境中的商业价值。其方法可推广至其他长尾分布严重的推荐场景，帮助企业改善冷启动和长尾商品曝光，提升整体转化和营收。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对长尾推荐这一实际难题，创新性地结合LLM语义ID和非对称知识迁移，解决了传统方法无法有效融合多模态与协同信号的问题。其工业级验证和显著业务提升，为生成式推荐在真实场景中的应用提供了有力证据，值得关注。

papers.title: Towards Sustainable Growth: A Multi-Value-Aware Retrieval Framework for E-Commerce Search
papers.abstract: New item growth is critical for maintaining a healthy ecosystem in large-scale e-commerce platforms. However, existing systems tend to prioritize presenting users with already popular items, a phenomenon often referred to as the "Matthew effect". In the context of search retrieval, current cold-start models suffer from the misalignment between training objectives and online business metrics, and they lack effective mechanisms to measure an item's growth potential. In this paper, we propose a Multi-Value-Aware retrieval framework tailored for e-commerce search, designed to better align with the cascaded online values across different stages of the search system while balancing immediate conversion and long-term item growth. Our framework GrowthGR consists of two key components: an Item Long-term Transaction Value Prediction (ItemLTV) module and a Multi-Value-Aware Generative Retrieval (MultiGR) module. First, in the ItemLTV module, we employ counterfactual inference to quantify the long-term value increment attributable to a single user interaction. Second, in the MultiGR module, building upon a semantic-ID-based generative retrieval architecture, we leverage structured samples with the search cascade signals and adopt a Multi-Value-Aware Policy Optimization (MoPO) training paradigm to align with multi-stage online values, while explicitly balancing short-term transactional value and long-term growth potential estimated by ItemLTV. We successfully deployed GrowthGR on Taobao's production platform, achieving a substantial 5.3% lift in new item GMV while delivering a non-trivial 0.3% gain in overall search GMV. Extensive online analysis and A/B testing demonstrate its positive impact on the overall ecosystem value.
papers.summary: 本文提出GrowthGR框架，用于电商搜索中的新品增长。现有系统受马太效应影响，冷启动模型训练目标与线上业务指标不一致，且缺乏衡量商品增长潜力的机制。GrowthGR包含两个模块：ItemLTV模块利用反事实推断量化单次用户交互带来的长期交易价值增量；MultiGR模块基于语义ID的生成式检索架构，使用搜索级联信号的结构化样本，并采用多价值感知策略优化（MoPO）训练范式，对齐多阶段线上价值，平衡短期交易价值和长期增长潜力。在淘宝生产平台部署后，新品GMV提升5.3%，整体搜索GMV提升0.3%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通过反事实推断和生成式检索，GrowthGR在电商搜索中有效平衡短期交易与长期增长，显著提升新品GMV。
papers.core_method: GrowthGR框架：ItemLTV模块使用反事实推断估计长期交易价值增量；MultiGR模块基于语义ID的生成式检索，采用多价值感知策略优化（MoPO）训练，结合搜索级联信号，平衡短期和长期价值。
innovation_points: 提出ItemLTV模块，利用反事实推断量化单次交互的长期价值增量，解决增长潜力度量问题。
构建MultiGR模块，基于语义ID的生成式检索架构，结合搜索级联信号，实现多阶段价值对齐。
设计MoPO训练范式，显式平衡短期交易价值和长期增长潜力，改善训练目标与线上指标不一致的问题。
experiment_results: 在淘宝生产平台部署后，新品GMV提升5.3%。
整体搜索GMV提升0.3%。
在线分析和A/B测试显示对整体生态价值有积极影响。
limitations: 反事实推断依赖假设，可能影响长期价值估计的准确性。
框架针对电商搜索场景设计，泛化到其他领域需调整。
未提供离线实验数据，仅依赖线上A/B测试结果。
papers.practical_value: 为电商平台提供可落地的检索框架，有效促进新品成长，平衡短期交易与长期生态健康，已在淘宝验证商业价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究直面电商搜索中的马太效应和冷启动问题，创新性地结合反事实推断与生成式检索，为工业界提供了一套可复用的解决方案，对提升平台生态价值具有重要参考意义。

papers.title: Efficient Generative Retrieval for E-commerce Search with Semantic Cluster IDs and Expert-Guided RL
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval offers a promising alternative by unifying the fragmented multi-stage retrieval process into a single end-to-end model. However, its practical adoption in industrial e-commerce search remains challenging, given the massive and dynamic product catalogs, strict latency requirements, and the need to align retrieval with downstream ranking goals. In this work, we propose a retrieval framework tailored for real-world recall scenarios, positioning generative retrieval as a recall-stage supplement rather than an end-to-end replacement. Our method, CQ-SID (Category-and-Query constrained Semantic ID), employs category-aware and query-item contrastive learning along with Residual Quantized VAEs to encode items into hierarchical semantic cluster identifiers, significantly reducing beam search complexity. Additionally, we develop EG-GRPO (Expert-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization), a reinforcement learning approach that aligns generative recall with downstream ranking under sparse rewards by injecting ground-truth samples to stabilize training. Offline experiments on TmallAPP search logs show that CQ-SID achieves up to 26.76% and 11.11% relative gains in semantic and personalized click hitrate over RQ-VAE baselines, while halving beam search size. EG-GRPO further improves multi-objective performance. Online A/B tests confirm gains in GMV (+1.15%) and UCTCVR (+0.40%). The generative recall channel now contributes substantially in production, accounting for over 50.25% of exposures, 58.96% of clicks, and 72.63% of purchases, demonstrating a viable path for deploying generative retrieval in real-world e-commerce systems.
papers.summary: 本文提出了一种面向工业级电商搜索的生成式检索框架CQ-SID与EG-GRPO。CQ-SID通过类别感知和查询-物品对比学习，结合残差量化VAE将物品编码为层次化语义簇ID，显著降低束搜索复杂度。EG-GRPO是一种专家引导的组相对策略优化方法，通过注入真实样本稳定训练，使生成式召回与下游排序目标对齐。离线实验基于天猫APP搜索日志，CQ-SID在语义和个性化点击命中率上较RQ-VAE基线分别提升26.76%和11.11%，同时束搜索规模减半；EG-GRPO进一步改善多目标性能。在线A/B测试显示GMV提升1.15%，UCTCVR提升0.40%。生产环境中，生成式召回通道贡献了50.25%的曝光、58.96%的点击和72.63%的购买，验证了其在真实电商系统中的可行路径。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 生成式检索可作为召回阶段的补充，通过语义簇ID和专家引导强化学习，在工业电商中实现显著业务增长。
papers.core_method: CQ-SID：结合类别感知和查询-物品对比学习，使用残差量化VAE生成层次化语义簇ID，降低束搜索复杂度；EG-GRPO：专家引导的组相对策略优化，注入真实样本稳定训练，对齐下游排序目标。
innovation_points: 将生成式检索定位为召回阶段的补充而非端到端替代，降低工业落地风险。
提出CQ-SID，利用类别和查询约束的对比学习与RQ-VAE生成语义ID，减少束搜索规模。
提出EG-GRPO，通过专家引导和真实样本注入解决稀疏奖励下的训练不稳定问题。
experiment_results: 离线实验：CQ-SID在语义和个性化点击命中率上较RQ-VAE基线分别提升26.76%和11.11%，束搜索规模减半。
在线A/B测试：GMV提升1.15%，UCTCVR提升0.40%。
生产部署：生成式召回通道贡献50.25%曝光、58.96%点击和72.63%购买。
limitations: 依赖大规模搜索日志和标注数据，冷启动场景可能受限。
语义ID的层次结构可能无法完全捕捉长尾或动态商品变化。
强化学习训练复杂度高，需要专家引导和调参。
papers.practical_value: 为电商搜索提供了一种可落地的生成式检索方案，显著提升召回效率和业务指标，已在生产环境中验证，可指导其他工业级检索系统设计。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文解决了生成式检索在工业场景中的关键挑战（规模、延迟、对齐），并提供了完整的离线-在线验证，展示了生成式检索的实际价值，对检索领域研究者和工程师具有重要参考意义。

papers.title: Mid-Training with Self-Generated Data Improves Reinforcement Learning in Language Models
papers.abstract: The effectiveness of Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Large Language Models (LLMs) depends on the nature and diversity of the data used before and during RL. In particular, reasoning problems can often be approached in multiple ways that rely on different forms of reasoning, and exposure to only a limited range of such approaches in the training data may limit the effectiveness of RL. Motivated by this, we investigate using diverse self-generated data during mid-training as an intermediate step before RL training. Specifically, we adopt a bootstrapped data-generation framework guided by George Polya's problem-solving approaches for generating multiple variants of correct answers for each question in the training data, and then perform fine-tuning. We first provide a theoretical perspective on how mid-training on such data improves RL and explain how policy-gradient updates can incentivize combining multiple approaches. We then empirically demonstrate that RL-trained models initialized with our mid-training data achieve consistent improvements across various mathematical reasoning benchmarks and other OOD tasks like code generation and narrative reasoning. Overall, our investigative study shows that a language model learning multiple problem-solving approaches, through self-generated data helps subsequent RL.
categories: Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare and Education
papers.summary: 本文研究了在强化学习（RL）之前使用自生成数据进行中期训练对语言模型推理性能的影响。作者基于波利亚的问题解决框架，引导模型为每个训练问题生成多种正确解答变体，并在此数据上进行微调。理论分析表明，中期训练可促使策略梯度更新隐式地组合多种推理路径，从而提升RL效率。实验证明，在数学推理基准及代码生成、叙事推理等OOD任务上，经过中期训练的模型在RL后均取得一致改进。研究强调多样化的自生成数据是提升RL效果的关键中间步骤。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 在RL前用自生成的多样化解题数据做中期训练，能显著提升后续RL的性能。
papers.core_method: 采用波利亚问题解决框架引导模型自生成多种正确解答变体，构建中期训练数据集，然后进行监督微调，最后再进行RL训练。
innovation_points: 提出在RL之前使用自生成多样化数据进行中期训练的新范式
从理论上解释了中期训练如何通过策略梯度更新促进多种推理方法的组合
在多个数学推理基准和OOD任务上验证了方法的有效性
experiment_results: 在数学推理基准上，RL模型经过中期训练后性能一致提升
在代码生成和叙事推理等OOD任务上也观察到改进
具体数值未在摘要中给出

方法依赖自生成数据的质量，可能受模型初始能力限制
未讨论计算成本增加的问题
papers.practical_value: 该方法可作为一种通用的预训练后处理步骤，提升LLM在数学、代码等推理任务上的RL微调效果，尤其适用于数据多样性不足的场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了数据多样性在RL中的重要性，提供了一种简单有效的自数据增强方法，为提升LLM推理能力提供了新思路。

papers.title: UniVA: Unified Value Alignment for Generative Recommendation in Online Advertising at Tencent
papers.abstract: Generative Recommendation (GR) reformulates recommendation as next-token generation over item Semantic IDs (SIDs) and has shown promise in industrial applications. However, extending GR to advertising is non-trivial, as advertising recommendation must jointly account for user relevance and commercial value. This creates a mismatch: high generation likelihood does not necessarily imply high advertising utility. As a result, valuable ads may be poorly distinguished in the SID space, pruned during autoregressive decoding, or missed when request-invalid branches consume limited beam capacity during online serving. To address this problem, we propose UniVA, a Unified Value Alignment framework for generative advertising recommendation. UniVA aligns commercial value across the entire pipeline of SID construction, autoregressive decoding, and online serving. Commercial SID Tokenization injects business attributes and bid information into SID construction. A Generation-as-Ranking SID Decoder then fuses generation scores with token-level value estimates during autoregressive decoding. {Finally, Value-Aware Constrained Serving restricts the fused decoding process to request-valid SID paths through a personalized trie.} Experiments on the Tencent WeChat Channels advertising platform show that UniVA achieves a 37.04\% relative improvement in offline Hit Rate@100 over the baseline and lifts gross merchandise value (GMV) by 1.5\% in online A/B tests.
papers.summary: 生成式推荐（GR）将推荐重构为基于物品语义ID（SID）的下一词生成，在工业应用中展现出潜力，但将其扩展到广告推荐面临挑战：广告推荐需同时考虑用户相关性和商业价值，导致高生成似然不一定意味着高广告效用，有价值的广告可能在SID空间中区分度低、在自回归解码中被剪枝，或在在线服务中因请求无效分支占用有限波束容量而丢失。为此，腾讯提出UniVA框架，在SID构建、自回归解码和在线服务全流程中对齐商业价值。商业SID分词将业务属性和出价信息注入SID构建；生成即排序SID解码器在解码时融合生成分数与token级价值估计；价值感知约束服务通过个性化trie限制解码到请求有效的SID路径。在腾讯微信视频号广告平台的实验中，UniVA离线Hit Rate@100相对提升37.04%，在线A/B测试中GMV提升1.5%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: UniVA通过在SID构建、解码和服务全流程中注入商业价值对齐，显著提升生成式广告推荐的商业效果。
papers.core_method: UniVA框架包含三个组件：商业SID分词（将业务属性和出价信息编码进SID构建）、生成即排序SID解码器（在自回归解码时融合生成分数与token级价值估计）、价值感知约束服务（通过个性化trie限制解码路径到请求有效的SID）。
innovation_points: 提出统一价值对齐框架，覆盖SID构建、解码和服务全流程，解决生成式推荐中商业价值与生成似然不匹配的问题。
商业SID分词将业务属性和出价信息直接注入SID，增强高价值广告的区分度。
生成即排序解码器融合生成分数与价值估计，避免高价值广告在解码中被剪枝。
价值感知约束服务通过个性化trie确保解码路径符合请求有效性，优化在线波束分配。
experiment_results: 离线Hit Rate@100相对提升37.04%（与基线相比）。
在线A/B测试中GMV提升1.5%。
limitations: 论文未提供更多离线指标（如NDCG、Recall）的详细数据。
在线提升仅报告GMV，未涉及其他商业指标（如CTR、转化率）。
框架依赖SID构建，可能受限于SID表示的质量和覆盖范围。
papers.practical_value: 为生成式推荐在广告场景的落地提供了完整解决方案，通过价值对齐显著提升商业收益，可直接应用于腾讯等大型平台的广告推荐系统，并可作为其他工业推荐系统的参考。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文是生成式推荐在真实广告场景中的首次系统性工业实践，解决了价值与生成似然不匹配的核心问题，展示了从离线到在线的完整技术路线，对学术研究和工业应用均有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Beyond Static Collision Handling: Adaptive Semantic ID Learning for Multimodal Recommendation at Industrial Scale
papers.abstract: Modern recommendation systems involve massive catalogs of multimodal items, where scalable item identification must balance compactness, semantic fidelity, and downstream effectiveness. Semantic IDs (SIDs) address this need by representing items as short discrete token sequences derived from multimodal signals, providing a compact interface for retrieval, ranking, and generative recommendation. However, effective SID learning is hindered by collisions, where different items are assigned identical or highly confusable codes. Existing methods mainly rely on improved quantization or fixed overlap regularization, but they do not adaptively distinguish whether an overlap should be suppressed or preserved. We propose AdaSID, an adaptive semantic ID learning framework for recommendation. AdaSID regulates SID overlaps through a two-stage process. First, it relaxes repulsion for observed overlaps when the involved items are semantically compatible, preserving admissible sharing rather than uniformly separating all collisions. Second, it allocates the remaining regulation pressure according to local collision load and training progress, strengthening control in congested regions while gradually rebalancing optimization toward recommendation alignment. This design adaptively decides which overlaps to penalize, how strongly to regulate them, and when to shift the learning focus. Extensive offline and online experiments validate AdaSID. On two public benchmarks, AdaSID improves Recall and NDCG by about 4.5% on average over strong baselines, while improving codebook utilization and SID diversity. In Kuaishou e-commerce, an online A/B test on short-video retrieval covering tens of millions of users achieves statistically significant gains, including a 0.98% GMV improvement, and industrial ranking evaluation shows consistent AUC improvements.
papers.summary: 现代推荐系统面临海量多模态物品的识别挑战，语义ID（SID）通过将物品表示为短离散token序列来平衡紧凑性、语义保真度和下游效果。然而，SID学习中的碰撞问题（不同物品被分配相同或高度混淆的编码）严重制约其性能。现有方法主要依赖改进量化或固定重叠正则化，但无法自适应区分重叠应被抑制还是保留。为此，我们提出AdaSID，一种自适应语义ID学习框架。AdaSID通过两阶段过程调节SID重叠：首先，对观察到的重叠，若涉及物品语义兼容则放宽排斥，保留可接受的共享；其次，根据局部碰撞负载和训练进度分配剩余调节压力，加强拥挤区域的控制，同时逐步将优化重心转向推荐对齐。该设计自适应决定惩罚哪些重叠、调节强度以及何时转移学习焦点。在公开基准上，AdaSID平均提升Recall和NDCG约4.5%，并改善码本利用率和SID多样性。在快手电商的短视频检索线上A/B测试中（覆盖数千万用户），取得统计显著提升，包括GMV提升0.98%，工业级排序评估显示AUC一致提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AdaSID通过自适应区分语义兼容与冲突的重叠，动态调节碰撞惩罚，显著提升多模态推荐中语义ID的学习质量与线上效果。
papers.core_method: AdaSID框架：两阶段自适应碰撞调节。第一阶段，对观察到的重叠，根据物品语义兼容性决定是否放宽排斥（保留可接受共享）；第二阶段，根据局部碰撞负载和训练进度动态分配调节压力，在拥挤区域加强控制，并逐步将优化重心从ID学习转向推荐对齐。
innovation_points: 提出自适应碰撞处理机制，区分语义兼容与冲突的重叠，避免一刀切惩罚。
动态调节调节压力，根据局部碰撞负载和训练进度分配，实现精细控制。
在工业规模验证，包括线上A/B测试和排序评估，展示实际价值。
experiment_results: 公开基准上，AdaSID平均提升Recall和NDCG约4.5%（相对强基线）。
快手电商线上A/B测试（数千万用户）中，GMV提升0.98%，统计显著。
工业排序评估显示AUC一致提升。
limitations: 依赖语义兼容性判断的准确性，可能受多模态表示质量影响。
调节压力分配策略需要额外超参数，调参成本可能较高。
未详细讨论计算开销，工业部署时需考虑效率。
papers.practical_value: AdaSID在快手电商场景中验证了线上GMV提升和排序AUC改进，表明其可直接应用于工业级多模态推荐系统，提升检索和排序效果，带来商业价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对语义ID学习中的碰撞问题提出自适应解决方案，突破了传统固定正则化的局限，并在大规模工业场景中验证有效性，对生成式推荐和语义ID研究具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: GenRec: A Preference-Oriented Generative Framework for Large-Scale Recommendation
papers.abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) offers a promising paradigm for recommendation through next-token prediction (NTP). However, scaling it to large-scale industrial systems introduces three challenges: (i) within a single request, the identical model inputs may produce inconsistent outputs due to the pagination request mechanism; (ii) the prohibitive cost of encoding long user behavior sequences with multi-token item representations based on semantic IDs, and (iii) aligning the generative policy with nuanced user preference signals. We present GenRec, a preference-oriented generative framework deployed on the JD App that addresses above challenges within a single decoder-only architecture. For training objective, we propose Page-wise NTP task, which supervises over an entire interaction page rather than each interacted item individually, providing denser gradient signal and resolving the one-to-many ambiguity of point-wise training. On the prefilling side, an asymmetric linear Token Merger compresses multi-token Semantic IDs in the prompt while preserving full-resolution decoding, reducing input length by ~2X with negligible accuracy loss. To further align outputs with user satisfaction, we introduce GRPO-SR, a reinforcement learning method that pairs Group Relative Policy Optimization with NLL regularization for training stability, and employs Hybrid Rewards combining a dense reward model with a relevance gate to mitigate reward hacking. In month-long online A/B tests serving production traffic, GenRec achieves 9.5% improvement in click count and 8.7% in transaction count over the existing pipeline.
papers.summary: GenRec是一个面向大规模推荐系统的偏好导向生成式框架，已在京东App部署。针对生成式检索在工业场景中的三大挑战：分页请求导致同一模型输入输出不一致、语义ID多token表示导致长用户行为序列编码成本高、生成策略与细粒度用户偏好信号对齐难，GenRec在单一decoder-only架构中提出Page-wise NTP训练目标，对整个交互页面进行监督，提供更密集的梯度信号并解决点式训练的一对多歧义；提出非对称线性Token Merger，压缩提示中的多token语义ID，同时保持解码全分辨率，将输入长度减少约2倍且精度损失可忽略；引入GRPO-SR强化学习方法，结合组相对策略优化与NLL正则化保证训练稳定性，并采用混合奖励（稠密奖励模型+相关性门控）缓解奖励黑客问题。在为期一个月的在线A/B测试中，GenRec相比现有流程，点击量提升9.5%，交易量提升8.7%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: GenRec通过页面级监督、输入压缩和偏好对齐强化学习，在京东大规模推荐中显著提升点击和交易量。
papers.core_method: GenRec采用decoder-only架构，核心方法包括：1) Page-wise NTP训练目标，对整个交互页面进行next-token预测，而非单个物品；2) 非对称线性Token Merger，压缩语义ID的token表示，减少输入长度；3) GRPO-SR强化学习，结合GRPO与NLL正则化，使用混合奖励（稠密奖励模型+相关性门控）进行偏好对齐。
innovation_points: 提出Page-wise NTP任务，以页面为单位监督，提供更密集梯度并解决点式训练的一对多歧义。
设计非对称线性Token Merger，压缩提示中的多token语义ID，输入长度减少约2倍，精度损失可忽略。
引入GRPO-SR，将GRPO与NLL正则化结合，并采用混合奖励机制，提升训练稳定性和偏好对齐效果。
experiment_results: 在线A/B测试（一个月，生产流量）中，点击量提升9.5%，交易量提升8.7%。
输入长度减少约2倍，精度损失可忽略。
limitations: 论文未提供离线实验的详细数据，如准确率、召回率等。
Token Merger的压缩率固定为2倍，可能未探索更优压缩比。
GRPO-SR的奖励模型设计依赖相关性门控，可能对特定场景敏感。
papers.practical_value: GenRec已在京东App部署，验证了生成式推荐在工业大规模系统中的可行性，显著提升用户点击和交易，为推荐系统提供了一种新的生成式范式，可直接应用于类似电商场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文解决了生成式检索在工业推荐中的实际工程挑战，如分页不一致、长序列编码成本、偏好对齐，提供了完整的解决方案和在线验证，对研究者和工程师具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: From Relevance to Authority: Authority-aware Generative Retrieval in Web Search Engines
papers.abstract: Generative information retrieval (GenIR) formulates the retrieval process as a text-to-text generation task, leveraging the vast knowledge of large language models. However, existing works primarily optimize for relevance while often overlooking document trustworthiness. This is critical in high-stakes domains like healthcare and finance, where relying solely on semantic relevance risks retrieving unreliable information. To address this, we propose an Authority-aware Generative Retriever (AuthGR), the first framework that incorporates authority into GenIR. AuthGR consists of three key components: (i) Multimodal Authority Scoring, which employs a vision-language model to quantify authority from textual and visual cues; (ii) a Three-stage Training Pipeline to progressively instill authority awareness into the retriever; and (iii) a Hybrid Ensemble Pipeline for robust deployment. Offline evaluations demonstrate that AuthGR successfully enhances both authority and accuracy, with our 3B model matching a 14B baseline. Crucially, large-scale online A/B tests and human evaluations conducted on the commercial web search platform confirm significant improvements in real-world user engagement and reliability.
papers.summary: 本文提出AuthGR，首个将权威性纳入生成式检索（GenIR）的框架。现有GenIR主要优化相关性，忽略文档可信度，在医疗、金融等高风险场景中可能检索到不可靠信息。AuthGR包含三个关键组件：多模态权威评分（利用视觉语言模型从文本和视觉线索量化权威性）、三阶段训练流程（逐步将权威意识注入检索器）和混合集成流程（用于稳健部署）。离线评估显示，AuthGR在提升权威性和准确性的同时，3B模型性能可与14B基线匹敌。在商业搜索引擎上的大规模在线A/B测试和人工评估证实了其在真实用户参与度和可靠性方面的显著提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AuthGR通过多模态权威评分和三阶段训练，在生成式检索中同时优化相关性和权威性，并在商业搜索引擎中验证了实际效果。
papers.core_method: AuthGR框架：1）多模态权威评分，使用视觉语言模型（VLM）从文本和视觉线索（如页面布局、图片）量化文档权威性；2）三阶段训练流程，逐步将权威性信号融入生成式检索器；3）混合集成流程，结合多个模型或策略以提升部署鲁棒性。
innovation_points: 首次将权威性显式纳入生成式检索（GenIR）框架，解决仅优化相关性导致的可信度问题。
提出多模态权威评分方法，利用视觉语言模型同时处理文本和视觉线索，更全面地评估文档权威性。
设计三阶段训练流程，渐进式地让检索器学习权威性，避免直接联合训练可能带来的不稳定。
在商业搜索引擎上进行了大规模在线A/B测试和人工评估，验证了框架的实际价值。
experiment_results: 离线评估显示，AuthGR在权威性和准确性上均优于基线，且3B模型性能与14B基线相当。
大规模在线A/B测试和人工评估证实，AuthGR显著提升了真实用户参与度和可靠性。
具体数值未在摘要中提供，但明确提及了显著改进。
limitations: 摘要未提供具体离线指标数值，难以量化改进幅度。
多模态权威评分依赖视觉语言模型，可能增加计算开销和部署复杂度。
框架在非商业场景（如学术搜索）的泛化性未在摘要中讨论。
papers.practical_value: AuthGR可直接应用于商业搜索引擎，提升高风险领域（如医疗、金融）的检索结果可信度，减少用户接触不可靠信息的风险。其在线A/B测试的成功表明，该框架具备实际部署价值，可改善用户体验和平台可靠性。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文填补了生成式检索中权威性研究的空白，提出了一种可落地的解决方案，并通过商业级验证证明了其有效性。对于关注检索质量、可信信息获取和LLM实际应用的研究者与工程师，本文提供了重要的技术路线和实证依据。

papers.title: UniRec: Bridging the Expressive Gap between Generative and Discriminative Recommendation via Chain-of-Attribute
papers.abstract: Generative Recommendation (GR) reframes retrieval and ranking as autoregressive decoding over Semantic IDs (SIDs), unifying the multi-stage pipeline into a single model. Yet a fundamental expressive gap persists: discriminative models score items with direct feature access enabling explicit user-item crossing, whereas GR decodes over compact SID tokens without item-side signal. We formalize this via Bayes' theorem: ranking by p(y|f,u) is equivalent to ranking by p(f|y,u), which factorizes autoregressively over item features, showing that a generative model with full feature access matches its discriminative counterpart, with any practical gap stemming solely from incomplete feature coverage. We propose UniRec with Chain-of-Attribute (CoA) as its core mechanism. CoA prefixes each SID sequence with structured attribute tokens:category, seller, brand, before decoding the SID, recovering the item-side feature crossing that discriminative models exploit. Since items sharing identical attributes cluster in adjacent SID regions, attribute conditioning yields a measurable per-step entropy reduction H(s_k|s<k,a) < H(s_k|s<k), narrowing the search space and stabilizing beam search. We further address two deployment challenges: Capacity-constrained SID introduces exposure-weighted capacity penalties into residual quantization to suppress token collapse and the Matthew effect; Conditional Decoding Context (CDC) combines Task-Conditioned BOS with hash-based Content Summaries to inject scenario signals at each decoding step. A joint RFT and DPO framework aligns the model with business objectives beyond distribution matching. Experiments show UniRec outperforms the strongest baseline by +22.6% HR@50 overall and +15.5% on high-value orders. Deployed on Shopee's e-commerce platform, online A/B tests confirm significant gains in PVCTR (+5.37%), orders (+4.76%), and GMV (+5.60%).
papers.summary: 生成式推荐（GR）将检索和排序重构为对语义ID（SID）的自回归解码，统一了多阶段流程，但存在表达差距：判别模型可直接访问物品特征进行用户-物品交叉，而GR仅解码紧凑的SID令牌，缺乏物品侧信号。本文通过贝叶斯定理形式化该差距，证明具有完整特征访问的生成模型可匹配判别模型，实际差距源于特征覆盖不全。为此提出UniRec，核心机制为属性链（CoA），在SID序列前添加结构化属性令牌（类别、卖家、品牌），恢复物品侧特征交叉，并通过属性条件降低每步熵，缩小搜索空间。同时解决部署挑战：容量受限SID引入曝光加权容量惩罚抑制令牌坍缩和马太效应；条件解码上下文（CDC）结合任务条件BOS和基于哈希的内容摘要注入场景信号。联合RFT和DPO框架对齐业务目标。实验显示UniRec在HR@50上比最强基线提升22.6%，高价值订单提升15.5%，在Shopee线上A/B测试中PVCTR提升5.37%，订单量提升4.76%，GMV提升5.60%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通过属性链（CoA）在生成式推荐中恢复物品侧特征交叉，显著提升性能并成功部署于电商平台。
papers.core_method: 提出UniRec框架，核心是Chain-of-Attribute（CoA）机制，在SID解码前注入结构化属性令牌（类别、卖家、品牌），实现物品侧特征交叉；结合容量受限SID（曝光加权容量惩罚）和条件解码上下文（CDC），并采用联合RFT和DPO对齐业务目标。
innovation_points: 形式化生成式与判别式推荐的表达差距，证明特征覆盖是关键。
提出CoA机制，通过属性条件降低解码熵，稳定束搜索。
设计容量受限SID和CDC解决部署中的令牌坍缩和场景信号注入问题。
联合RFT和DPO框架优化业务目标。
experiment_results: 离线实验：UniRec在HR@50上比最强基线提升22.6%，高价值订单提升15.5%。
线上A/B测试：PVCTR提升5.37%，订单量提升4.76%，GMV提升5.60%。
limitations: 依赖属性信息的完整性和质量，属性缺失可能影响性能。
CoA机制增加序列长度，可能带来推理开销。
容量受限SID的惩罚系数需要调参，可能影响泛化。
papers.practical_value: UniRec已在Shopee电商平台部署，显著提升点击率、订单量和GMV，证明生成式推荐在真实业务场景中的可行性和商业价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文弥合了生成式与判别式推荐的表达差距，提出实用的CoA机制，解决了部署中的关键问题，并在大规模电商平台验证了有效性，为生成式推荐的实际应用提供了重要参考。

papers.title: R3-VAE: Reference Vector-Guided Rating Residual Quantization VAE for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Generative Recommendation (GR) has gained traction for its merits of superior performance and cold-start capability. As the vital role in GR, Semantic Identifiers (SIDs) represent item semantics through discrete tokens. However, current techniques for SID generation based on vector quantization face two main challenges: (i) training instability, stemming from insufficient gradient propagation through the straight-through estimator and sensitivity to initialization; and (ii) inefficient SID quality assessment, where industrial practice still depends on costly GR training and A/B testing. To address these challenges, we propose Reference Vector-Guided Rating Residual Quantization VAE (R3-VAE). This framework incorporates three key innovations: (i) a reference vector that functions as a semantic anchor for the initial features, thereby mitigating sensitivity to initialization; (ii) a dot product-based rating mechanism designed to stabilize the training process and prevent codebook collapse; and (iii) two SID evaluation metrics, Semantic Cohesion and Preference Discrimination, serving as regularization terms during training. Empirical results on six benchmarks demonstrate that R3-VAE outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an average improvement of 14.5% in Recall@10 and 15.5% in NDCG@10 across three public datasets (Beauty, Sports, and Toys). Furthermore, we perform GR training and online A/B tests on Toutiao. Our method achieves a 1.62% improvement in MRR and a 0.83% gain in StayTime/U versus baselines. Additionally, we employ R3-VAE to replace the item ID of CTR model, resulting in significant improvements in content cold start by 15.36%, corroborating the strong applicability and business value in industry-scale recommendation scenarios.
papers.summary: 生成式推荐（GR）依赖语义标识符（SIDs）表示物品语义，但现有基于向量量化的SID生成面临训练不稳定和评估低效两大挑战。本文提出R3-VAE框架，通过参考向量锚定初始特征缓解初始化敏感，基于点积的评分机制稳定训练并防止码本崩溃，并设计语义内聚性和偏好判别性两个评估指标作为正则项。在六个基准数据集上，R3-VAE在Beauty、Sports、Toys上平均提升Recall@10 14.5%、NDCG@10 15.5%。在头条的在线A/B测试中，MRR提升1.62%，StayTime/U提升0.83%，并将CTR模型中的物品ID替换为R3-VAE生成的SID，内容冷启动提升15.36%，验证了工业场景的适用性和商业价值。
papers.one_line_takeaway: R3-VAE通过参考向量和点积评分机制稳定SID生成，并引入可计算评估指标，显著提升生成式推荐性能及工业冷启动效果。
papers.core_method: 提出R3-VAE框架，包含三个关键创新：参考向量作为语义锚点缓解初始化敏感；基于点积的评分机制稳定训练并防止码本崩溃；两个SID评估指标（语义内聚性和偏好判别性）作为正则项。
innovation_points: 引入参考向量作为语义锚点，减少对初始化的敏感性，提升训练稳定性。
设计基于点积的评分机制，替代传统距离度量，稳定梯度传播并防止码本坍缩。
提出两个SID评估指标（语义内聚性和偏好判别性），可在线下评估SID质量，避免依赖昂贵GR训练和A/B测试。
在工业级场景（头条）验证了方法，包括在线A/B测试和CTR模型替换，展示实际业务价值。
experiment_results: 在Beauty、Sports、Toys三个公开数据集上，平均Recall@10提升14.5%，NDCG@10提升15.5%，优于现有最先进方法。
在头条在线A/B测试中，MRR提升1.62%，StayTime/U提升0.83%。
将R3-VAE生成的SID替换CTR模型中的物品ID，内容冷启动提升15.36%。
limitations: 论文未详细说明六个基准数据集的完整结果，仅报告了三个公开数据集的平均提升。
参考向量和评分机制的设计可能依赖特定数据分布，泛化性需进一步验证。
评估指标作为正则项可能增加训练复杂度，实际部署成本未详细讨论。
papers.practical_value: R3-VAE在工业推荐系统中具有直接应用价值：通过稳定SID生成和线下评估，减少对昂贵A/B测试的依赖；在头条的实验中，显著提升MRR、用户停留时间和内容冷启动效果，表明可有效改善推荐质量和用户体验，并支持CTR模型等下游任务。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对生成式推荐中SID生成的训练不稳定和评估低效问题，提出了创新的解决方案，并在工业规模场景中验证了实际效果。其参考向量和评分机制为后续研究提供了新思路，评估指标的设计也推动了SID质量的可衡量性，对学术和工业界均有重要参考价值。

papers.title: MBGR: Multi-Business Prediction for Generative Recommendation at Meituan
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for industrial recommendations. GR leverages Semantic IDs (SIDs) to reduce the encoding-decoding space and employs the Next Token Prediction (NTP) framework to explore scaling laws. However, existing GR methods suffer from two critical issues: (1) a \textbf{seesaw phenomenon} in multi-business scenarios arises due to NTP's inability to capture complex cross-business behavioral patterns; and (2) a unified SID space causes \textbf{representation confusion} by failing to distinguish distinct semantic information across businesses. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Business Generative Recommendation (MBGR), the first GR framework tailored for multi-business scenarios. Our framework comprises three key components. First, we design a Business-aware semantic ID (BID) module that preserves semantic integrity via domain-aware tokenization. Then, we introduce a Multi-Business Prediction (MBP) structure to provide business-specific prediction capabilities. Furthermore, we develop a Label Dynamic Routing (LDR) module that transforms sparse multi-business labels into dense labels to further enhance the multi-business generation capability. Extensive offline and online experiments on Meituan's food delivery platform validate MBGR's effectiveness, and we have successfully deployed it in production.
papers.summary: 生成式推荐（GR）在工业推荐中展现出潜力，但现有方法在多业务场景下存在跷跷板现象和表示混淆问题。本文提出MBGR框架，包含业务感知语义ID（BID）模块、多业务预测（MBP）结构和标签动态路由（LDR）模块，分别解决语义完整性、业务特定预测和标签稀疏性问题。在美团外卖平台上的离线与在线实验验证了其有效性，并已成功部署。
papers.one_line_takeaway: MBGR通过业务感知语义ID、多业务预测结构和标签动态路由，解决了多业务生成式推荐中的跷跷板现象和表示混淆问题，并在美团成功部署。
papers.core_method: MBGR框架：BID模块通过领域感知分词保留语义完整性；MBP结构提供业务特定预测能力；LDR模块将稀疏多业务标签转换为密集标签以增强生成能力。
innovation_points: 首次提出针对多业务场景的生成式推荐框架MBGR。
设计业务感知语义ID（BID）模块，解决统一SID空间中的表示混淆。
引入多业务预测（MBP）结构和标签动态路由（LDR），缓解跷跷板现象并增强生成能力。
experiment_results: 离线实验验证了MBGR在美团外卖平台上的有效性。
在线实验显示MBGR优于现有方法，并已成功部署于生产环境。
limitations: 论文未提供具体实验数据，如离线指标提升幅度或在线收益。
框架依赖业务感知分词，可能对业务数量或类型变化敏感。
LDR模块的标签动态路由机制可能增加训练复杂度。
papers.practical_value: MBGR已在美团外卖平台部署，证明其工业可行性，为多业务推荐系统提供了可落地的生成式推荐方案，有助于提升跨业务推荐效果和用户体验。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对生成式推荐在多业务场景中的实际挑战提出系统性解决方案，并成功落地，对工业推荐领域具有重要参考价值，尤其对处理多业务复杂交互和语义ID设计有启发。

papers.title: RCLRec: Reverse Curriculum Learning for Modeling Sparse Conversions in Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Conversion objectives in large-scale recommender systems are sparse, making them difficult to optimize. Generative recommendation (GR) partially alleviates data sparsity by organizing multi-type behaviors into a unified token sequence with shared representations, but conversion signals remain insufficiently modeled. While recent behavior-aware GR models encode behavior types and employ behavior-aware attention to highlight decision-related intermediate behaviors, they still rely on standard attention over the full history and provide no additional supervision for conversions, leaving conversion sparsity largely unresolved. To address these challenges, we propose RCLRec, a reverse curriculum learning-based GR framework for sparse conversion supervision. For each conversion target, RCLRec constructs a short curriculum by selecting a subsequence of conversion-related items from the history in reverse. Their semantic tokens are fed to the decoder as a prefix, together with the target conversion tokens, under a joint generation objective. This design provides additional instance-specific intermediate supervision, alleviating conversion sparsity and focusing the model on the user's critical decision process. We further introduce a curriculum quality-aware loss to ensure that the selected curricula are informative for conversion prediction. Experiments on offline datasets and an online A/B test show that RCLRec achieves superior performance, with +2.09% advertising revenue and +1.86% orders in online deployment.
papers.summary: 大规模推荐系统中的转化目标稀疏，难以优化。生成式推荐（GR）通过将多类型行为统一为token序列并共享表示，部分缓解了数据稀疏问题，但转化信号仍建模不足。现有行为感知GR模型虽编码行为类型并采用行为感知注意力突出决策相关中间行为，但仍依赖全历史的标准注意力，且未对转化提供额外监督，转化稀疏问题未根本解决。为此，本文提出RCLRec，一种基于反向课程学习的GR框架，用于稀疏转化监督。对每个转化目标，RCLRec从历史中选取转化相关物品的子序列，按反向顺序构建短课程，将其语义token作为前缀与目标转化token一起输入解码器，采用联合生成目标。该设计提供额外的实例级中间监督，缓解转化稀疏，并聚焦用户关键决策过程。进一步引入课程质量感知损失，确保所选课程对转化预测有信息量。离线数据集和在线A/B测试表明，RCLRec性能优越，在线部署中广告收入+2.09%，订单+1.86%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RCLRec通过反向课程学习为生成式推荐提供转化相关的中间监督，有效缓解转化稀疏问题，并在在线业务中显著提升广告收入和订单量。
papers.core_method: RCLRec框架：对每个转化目标，从用户历史中选取转化相关物品子序列，按反向顺序构建短课程，将其语义token作为解码器前缀，与目标转化token联合生成，并引入课程质量感知损失优化课程选择。
innovation_points: 提出反向课程学习策略，为转化目标构建短课程，提供实例级中间监督，缓解转化稀疏。
将课程token作为解码器前缀，与目标转化token联合生成，增强模型对用户决策过程的建模。
设计课程质量感知损失，确保所选课程对转化预测具有信息量。
experiment_results: 离线数据集上性能优于基线（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
在线A/B测试中，广告收入提升2.09%，订单量提升1.86%。
limitations: 摘要未提供离线实验的具体性能数值，仅提及优于基线。
课程构建依赖转化相关物品的选择，可能受历史数据质量影响。
方法在非转化场景或冷启动用户上的效果未在摘要中说明。
papers.practical_value: 在电商或广告推荐系统中，转化稀疏是常见痛点。RCLRec通过反向课程学习提供额外监督，可提升转化预测准确性，直接带来广告收入和订单量的增长，具有明确的商业价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对生成式推荐中转化稀疏这一关键问题，提出新颖的反向课程学习框架，不仅改进了模型性能，还通过在线实验验证了实际业务价值，为生成式推荐在稀疏目标优化方面提供了新思路。

papers.title: OneSearch-V2: The Latent Reasoning Enhanced Self-distillation Generative Search Framework
papers.abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for modern search systems. Compared to multi-stage cascaded architecture, it offers advantages such as end-to-end joint optimization and high computational efficiency. OneSearch, as a representative industrial-scale deployed generative search framework, has brought significant commercial and operational benefits. However, its inadequate understanding of complex queries, inefficient exploitation of latent user intents, and overfitting to narrow historical preferences have limited its further performance improvement. To address these challenges, we propose OneSearch-V2, a latent reasoning enhanced self-distillation generative search framework. It contains three key innovations: (1) a thought-augmented complex query understanding module, which enables deep query understanding and overcomes the shallow semantic matching limitations of direct inference; (2) a reasoning-internalized self-distillation training pipeline, which uncovers users' potential yet precise e-commerce intentions beyond log-fitting through implicit in-context learning; (3) a behavior preference alignment optimization system, which mitigates reward hacking arising from the single conversion metric, and addresses personal preference via direct user feedback. Extensive offline evaluations demonstrate OneSearch-V2's strong query recognition and user profiling capabilities. Online A/B tests further validate its business effectiveness, yielding +3.98\% item CTR, +2.07\% buyer volume, and +2.11\% order volume. Manual evaluation further confirms gains in search experience quality, with +1.37\% in page good rate and +1.65\% in query-item relevance. More importantly, OneSearch-V2 effectively mitigates common search system issues such as information bubbles and long-tail sparsity, without incurring additional inference costs or serving latency.
papers.summary: OneSearch-V2 是一个面向工业级生成式搜索的潜在推理增强自蒸馏框架，旨在解决现有生成式检索（GR）系统在复杂查询理解、潜在用户意图利用和历史偏好过拟合方面的不足。该框架包含三个关键创新：思维增强的复杂查询理解模块，通过生成思维链实现深度查询理解；推理内化的自蒸馏训练流程，利用隐式上下文学习挖掘用户潜在意图；行为偏好对齐优化系统，缓解单一转化指标导致的奖励黑客问题。离线评估显示其查询识别和用户画像能力增强，在线A/B测试带来商品点击率提升3.98%、买家数提升2.07%、订单量提升2.11%，人工评估显示页面好评率提升1.37%、查询-商品相关性提升1.65%，且无额外推理成本或延迟。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OneSearch-V2通过潜在推理增强和自蒸馏训练，在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升生成式搜索的复杂查询理解和用户意图挖掘能力。
papers.core_method: OneSearch-V2包含三个核心模块：1）思维增强的复杂查询理解模块，通过生成思维链来增强查询语义理解；2）推理内化的自蒸馏训练流程，将推理过程内化到模型参数中，通过隐式上下文学习挖掘用户潜在意图；3）行为偏好对齐优化系统，结合直接用户反馈和多种指标来对齐用户偏好，缓解奖励黑客问题。

设计推理内化的自蒸馏训练流程，通过隐式上下文学习挖掘用户潜在意图
构建行为偏好对齐优化系统，缓解单一转化指标导致的奖励黑客问题
在不增加推理成本的前提下实现性能提升，适合工业部署

papers.title: Seed1.8 Model Card: Towards Generalized Real-World Agency
papers.abstract: We present Seed1.8, a foundation model aimed at generalized real-world agency: going beyond single-turn prediction to multi-turn interaction, tool use, and multi-step execution. Seed1.8 keeps strong LLM and vision-language performance while supporting a unified agentic interface-search, code generation and execution, and GUI interaction. For deployment, it offers latency- and cost-aware inference, including configurable thinking modes and optimized visual encoding for images and video. We report evaluations on standard benchmarks and application-aligned workflows spanning foundational skills, multimodal understanding, and agentic behavior. Seed1.8 is released to support further research and development on interactive, real-world use cases.
papers.summary: Seed1.8是字节跳动Seed团队发布的基础模型，旨在实现通用真实世界代理能力，超越单轮预测，支持多轮交互、工具使用和多步执行。模型在保持强大LLM和视觉语言性能的同时，统一了搜索、代码生成与执行、GUI交互等代理接口。部署上提供延迟和成本感知的推理，包括可配置思考模式和优化的图像视频视觉编码。评估覆盖标准基准和应用对齐工作流，涉及基础技能、多模态理解和代理行为。Seed1.8已发布以支持交互式真实世界用例的研究与开发。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Seed1.8通过统一代理接口和高效推理设计，将基础模型能力扩展到真实世界多步任务，但具体技术细节和实验数据未公开。
